sword.name: Sword
sword.internalNote: Free baseline: 12 DPS, balanced against the reach and utility of paid weapons.

mace.name: Mace
mace.description: A slow melee weapon that splashes nearby enemies for 10% damage.
mace.internalNote: 11.2 primary DPS; clustered enemies improve value. Slow attacks risk overkill.

bow.name: Bow
bow.description: A ranged weapon that fires small traveling arrows.
bow.internalNote: 8 DPS trades raw damage for early attacks at 350 range; no active kiting.

ballista.name: Ballista
ballista.description: Fires a large bolt for 50 damage every five seconds at 500 range. Reduces movement by 20%.
ballista.internalNote: 10 sustained DPS with high opening burst and reach. The 100 GP price, slow reload and movement penalty limit flexibility.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: A tank weapon granting 50 bonus HP and dealing 5 melee damage per second.
shield.internalNote: Trades damage for durability; weapon HP stacks with armor, enabling durable frontline builds. Default price is 30 GP.

fastBow.name: Fast Bow
fastBow.description: Fires two arrows per second for 5 damage each at 250 range.
fastBow.internalNote: 10 DPS with frequent small hits reduces overkill, but the 80 GP price limits spending on armor and mobility.

spear.name: Spear
spear.description: A long-reach melee weapon dealing 15 damage at 0.8 attacks per second.
spear.internalNote: 12 DPS matches the sword while greater reach improves frontline access; slower attacks make missed finishing opportunities more costly.

catapult.name: Catapult
catapult.description: Hurls a stone at a fixed landing point, dealing 60 damage to enemies within 150 units after 1.0 seconds.
catapult.internalNote: Initial balance: 100 GP, one shot every five seconds, 30% movement penalty. Strong against clusters; moving enemies can dodge the fixed impact area.

stone throw.name: Stone Throw
stone throw.description: Throws a stone for 10 damage at 50 range.
stone throw.internalNote: Low-cost, low-damage option for early skirmishes or cheap ranged harassment.

healer.name: Healer Staff
healer.description: Heals living allies within 50 units of an injured friendly target for 20 HP once per second. Cast range 400.
healer.internalNote: Affordable area sustain with no damage. Targets the lowest HP percentage ally, including self; cannot overheal or revive.

none.name: No armor
none.internalNote: Free baseline with no movement penalty; leaves GP for weapons or mobility.

light.name: Light armor
light.internalNote: Low-cost durability that preserves mobility; less HP per GP than heavier armor.

heavy.name: Heavy armor
heavy.description: Adds 50 HP and reduces movement by 10%.
heavy.internalNote: Efficient frontline durability, offset by slower engagement against ranged enemies.

plate.name: Plate armor
plate.description: Adds 80 HP and reduces movement by 20%.
plate.internalNote: Strongest durability at the highest armor cost; stacks multiplicatively with other movement modifiers.

carbon fiber plate.name: Carbon Fiber Plate armor
carbon fiber plate.description: Adds 200 HP and increases movement by 20%.
carbon fiber plate.internalNote: Exceptional durability with a mobility bonus; stacks multiplicatively with other movement modifiers.

regenerative.name: Regenerative Armor
regenerative.description: Adds 10 HP and regenerates 5 HP per second without changing movement speed.
regenerative.internalNote: Low initial durability but strong sustain in prolonged fights. Burst damage can overcome regeneration; healing cannot exceed maximum HP or revive dead warriors.

giant.name: Giant
giant.description: Doubles warrior size, hitbox radius, maximum HP and damage; halves movement speed.
giant.internalNote: Expensive frontline power. HP multiplier includes weapon bonuses. Larger bodies crowd the frontline; healing amount is not damage and is not doubled.

none.name: No mount / boots
none.description: Standard movement without boots or a mount.
none.internalNote: Free baseline; no speed bonus, preserving GP for damage and durability.

boots.name: Boots
boots.internalNote: Affordable mobility with a modest effect on closing ranged gaps.

fast.name: Fast boots
fast.internalNote: Mid-cost mobility option with better speed gain per GP than basic boots.

horse.name: Horse
horse.internalNote: Largest mobility boost helps melee close distance; costs a third of the initial team budget.

standard.name: Standard
standard.description: Move toward the nearest enemy and stop in weapon range.
standard.internalNote: Free baseline; no targeting or retreat advantage.

ranged.name: Ranged
ranged.description: Move at half speed, targeting the enemy with the lowest current HP.
ranged.internalNote: Finishes wounded enemies, but reduced mobility increases vulnerability and delays engagement.

sniper.name: Ranged Sniper
sniper.description: Target the highest HP enemy until threatened, then retreat and fire at the incoming enemy while keeping it in weapon range.
sniper.internalNote: Retreat distance is capped by weapon range. Keep attacking the pursuer until it dies or leaves range; this improves survival but can force timeouts.

specOps.name: Spec Ops
specOps.description: Pursue the nearest ranged enemy; target the nearest melee enemy if no ranged enemies remain.
specOps.internalNote: Counters vulnerable ranged backlines but may bypass dangerous melee enemies.
